Definition: The branch of biology concerned with the study of cells
Context: Scientists use cytology to understand cellular processes

Definition: A fundamental principle stating all living organisms are composed of cells
Context: Cell theory is foundational to modern biology

Definition: Simple cells without a membrane-bound nucleus
Context: Bacteria are prokaryotic organisms

Definition: Complex cells with a membrane-bound nucleus and organelles
Context: Animals and plants have eukaryotic cells

Definition: Selectively permeable barrier separating cell interior from environment
Context: The plasma membrane controls what enters and exits the cell

Definition: Control center of eukaryotic cells containing DNA
Context: The nucleus houses genetic material

Definition: Organelles responsible for cellular respiration and ATP production
Context: Mitochondria are called the powerhouse of the cell

Definition: Organelles where photosynthesis occurs in plant cells
Context: Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll for photosynthesis

Definition: Small structures where protein synthesis occurs
Context: Ribosomes can be free or attached to ER

Definition: Network of membranous tubules involved in synthesis
Context: ER can be rough or smooth depending on ribosomes

Definition: Organelle that modifies and packages proteins
Context: The Golgi apparatus is like a cellular post office

Definition: Organelles containing digestive enzymes
Context: Lysosomes are the recycling centers of cells

Definition: Membrane-bound sacs used for storage
Context: Plant cells have large central vacuoles

Definition: Movement of molecules from high to low concentration
Context: Diffusion requires no energy input

Definition: Diffusion of water across a selectively permeable membrane
Context: Osmosis is crucial for cell hydration

Definition: Movement of molecules against concentration gradient using ATP
Context: Active transport requires cellular energy

Definition: Process where cells engulf external materials
Context: Endocytosis brings substances into the cell

Definition: Process where cells expel materials in vesicles
Context: Exocytosis releases waste or secretions

Definition: Adenosine triphosphate - the primary energy currency of cells
Context: Cells use ATP to power most processes

Definition: Process converting light energy into chemical energy
Context: Plants perform photosynthesis in chloroplasts

Definition: Process breaking down glucose to produce ATP
Context: Cellular respiration occurs in mitochondria

Definition: Rigid structure outside plasma membrane in plant cells
Context: The cell wall provides structural support

Definition: Gel-like substance filling the cell
Context: The cytoplasm contains organelles and cytosol

Definition: Structure made of condensed chromatin carrying genetic information
Context: Humans have 46 chromosomes

Definition: Double layer of phospholipid molecules forming cell membranes
Context: The bilayer has hydrophobic and hydrophilic regions
